scope: Curated primary-source mechanical engineering and design-as-code search. This is not an exhaustive collection of worldwide doctoral work.
policy: Metadata, methodology and task ideas only. Public access does not grant unrestricted training rights. Author new exercises, verify them independently, group splits by parent design/problem family, and reserve benchmarks for evaluation.

sources.title: Improving heat transfer in an air-cooled engine by redesigning the fins
sources.rights: CC-BY-4.0; verified on PDF first page
sources.reviewed: Eight-page PDF, tables and page-three visual inspection
sources.use: Study reports single-cylinder 6063-T6, not Porsche alloy. Section 3.1 claims 250 cm^3; Table 1 gives bore 50 mm and stroke 70 mm, implying 137.445 cm^3. Table 3 masses 0.89/0.96 kg imply 7.865% increase, versus 8.23% in the text. These discrepancies require clarification. Temperature differences alone do not independently establish heat rate.
